_comment: Smithing rework (Nate, 9 Oct; ~/claude-nate-release/specs/smithing-rework-1009.md): the Blacksmith's 7 craft tiers and the families each one opens, read by smithing.js and manuals.js. id is the family key of loot-materials.json (an item's family comes from there). A family above T1 needs its technique (a manual, private.dboManuals); free: none needed (the tier gate only); technique: <id> = worked with that family's technique. book: 'staff' = never shop or loot (given in roleplay); 'apprentice' = no book, learned only by apprenticeship (supervisorRace). where: the learnHint shown in the F3 Blacksmith tab. bookId: the family's BOOK record (the PC's DBO_Schematics_<family> in DragonBreak Online Edits, 9 Oct); config smithing.books { <id>: '<hex>:<plugin>' } overrides it.py classifies them.
